requirement:
The combined coverage overview MUST restrict its expandable details to coverage
gaps, explanation status, and coverage-check findings. It MUST NOT include a
test-run provenance table or embed per-test coverage data.
rationale:
The requirement has two obligations. (1) The combined overview's expandable details MUST be limited to coverage gaps, explanation status and coverage-check findings. (2) The overview MUST NOT include a test-run provenance table or embed per-test coverage data. Both are tested.

**Obligation 1: allowed expandable sections.**
- `src/execution_coverage/check.rs#mod[tests]/fn[book_verdict_and_gaps_follow_the_native_policy_and_current_reviews]` defines the `assert_details` closure. It regex-extracts every `<details class="…">` in the rendered "Coverage gaps" page. It asserts that each class is one of `gap-directory`, `gap-explanation`, `gap-accepted-group` or `gap-footer`.
- Those classes correspond to gap directories, explanation status, documented accepted gaps and coverage-check findings. The implementation emits exactly these in `book.rs` (`GapDirectory::render`, `explanation_html`, `gaps_map`).
- The closure runs in several states: missing review, accepted, rejected, and below-target with file-level and function-level obligations. An extra expandable section such as a per-test or provenance `<details>` would therefore fail the test.
- The same test asserts that the `gap-footer` "Coverage-check findings" section is present when the review is rejected.

**Obligation 2: no provenance table and no per-test data.**
- `assert_details` also asserts that the output contains neither "Test runs and provenance" nor `habeas-coverage-test`.
- `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[gaps_union_process_locations_and_omit_per_test_reports]` renders the index overview from a recorded run named "binary / one". It asserts there is no `habeas-coverage-test` marker, no "Test runs and provenance", no "binary / one" and no `<select`. It also asserts that every chapter after the first is a "File notes:" chapter, so no per-test report chapters are embedded.

**Assessment.** Both tests carry `{test}` references to the subject. The assertions can fail on the prohibited behavior. The tests cover the index page and the Coverage gaps page, so the required modes are exercised. I found no unacknowledged gap.
